## Description (paste into KDP; basic HTML allowed)
<b>Big, friendly dotted lines for little hands!</b>
Trace along with Leo the Little Explorer through soft pastel pages that build the very first pre-writing skills, one gentle step at a time.
<ul>
<li>12 warm-up line pages – straight, wavy, zig-zag, hops, arches, loops and swirls</li>
<li>10 shape pages – circle to diamond, plus a shape house</li>
<li>8 follow-the-path pages</li>
<li>10 number pages – trace, count and colour 1 to 10</li>
<li>26 letter pages – trace A to Z and colour a picture for every letter</li>
<li>Green start dots and arrows, grown-up tips, a progress map and a certificate</li>
</ul>
Best with chunky crayons or pencils. For ages 2–4 with a grown-up.
